links.claim: TGIF1 is expressed in MCF7. This chain hypothesizes a regulatory element at the variant, but no overlapping regulatory annotation or cCRE is reported.
PELI2 is a speculative target based on proximity alone; no variant-to-PELI2 regulatory connection is shown.
MCF7 is a nominated context because TGIF1 is expressed there; locus occupancy or regulatory activity has not been established.
A PELI2-mediated breast-cancer consequence is unestablished; the available association and literature results do not establish this mechanism.

predictions: A TGIF1-specific perturbation should change any allele-dependent regulatory effect more than CREB3L4 or TET3 perturbation; the direction of downstream activity is unknown.
If PELI2 is the target, the allele-dependent effect should be detectable at PELI2 rather than inferred from proximity alone.
falsified_if: TGIF1-specific assays show no allele-dependent binding or regulatory effect at the locus.
TGIF1 or variant perturbation does not alter PELI2 regulation.
